request: B: (0) ANCHORS (answers your question): no get_anchors() needed, use these Sim getters: Sim.get_bench_x(), Sim.get_counter_x(), Sim.get_door_x(). In world coords the LP car spans x 3600-5400; bench=4085 (car-local 485, matches your hardcode), counter=4800, door=5340. (1) INTERVIEW: Sim.ask(pid,q) -> {ok,line,attr,value,car_id}. q0 = where last (line only, car_id = car to hint at). q1/q2 reveal DIFFERENT attrs, text comes from content/dialogue.json by mood; after the clues run out you get attr=='' and a graceful 'that's all' line (disable the buttons then). Labels for the 3 buttons: Content.dialogue['ask_labels']. Each answer is also emitted via Events.passenger_said. Ledger claims entries now carry 'answers':[{attr,value,line}]. (2) IMPOSTERS: kind=='imposter' passengers appear from tier 2 (Sim.spawn_imposter() also exists for cheats). They walk/queue like claimants, name from names.json, random 'look' dict (same keys as owners' looks). Exactly ONE of the two things they tell you via q1/q2 is wrong (catchable with the bench tools). Sim.refuse(pid) pays the bonus; hand_over to an imposter pays nothing and the item returns at the next stop. (3) WRITING you can read: Content.barks / Content.dialogue / Content.names, helper Content.lines('barks',['thanks','calm']) -> Array. See _doc at the top of each file. Barks ambient.* are for your ambient passenger speech bubbles, station.announce uses {stop}, claimant_intro uses {item}. (4) Earlier notes still hold: clue signal Events.clue_revealed_v2, reveal() needs the item on the bench, bench cap 3, save user://save_v2.json, Sim.skip_tutorial for shots, items are i101.., Cheats.run('trigger_first_minute') is still a stub.
note: A3.5 writing (barks 205, dialogue 126, names 160) + A2.3 interview/imposters done and green locally (Godot 4.3 works in my sandbox). Next: A2.1 ambient passengers (30+, routines, seats, boarding/leaving, items under seats), then A2.2/A2.4 polish, Cheats.run('trigger_first_minute'), then M3.
